svg.title: Attention tensors and their GPU owners
svg.desc: Ulysses exchanges token and head ownership. A compact ring keeps query blocks local and rotates the latent and positional-key blocks.

g.text: Attention tensors and their GPU owners
1,048,576 tokens per sequence · 128 heads · four equal token blocks in the ownership diagrams
Ulysses · move from token owners to head owners
fwd Project keys and values, then exchange queries / keys / values.
A cell names the GPU holding that token block and those heads.
Each head owner attends over the full sequence.
fwd Return the attention output to its token owner.
bwd Reverse the exchanges and reduce-scatter positional-key gradients.
Compact ring · keep each query block local
KV block = normalized latent + shared positional key.
Future blocks travel onward while their attention math is skipped.
fwd Expand each arriving block into keys and values.
fwd Merge softmax statistics and weighted value sums.
bwd Replay blocks and return latent and positional-key gradients.
Communication per GPU, per attention layer, per sequence
Logical BF16 payload in GiB. All bars use the same scale. Gradient transfers also use BF16 here.
Ulysses sends the displayed amount in each pass. KV expansions count whole token-block projections across the CP group.
The ring bwd total includes KV replay, accumulated gradients and the final gradient-only hop to the original owner.
Compact all-gather control · four GPUs · 0.84 GiB fwd and 0.84 GiB bwd
Each query owner retains all four latent / positional-key blocks and reduce-scatters their gradients.
The ring consumes successive blocks and replays them in bwd. These figures compare payload and residency.
